question: What does refusing a bare-lowercase REFERENCES terminal do to the graph?
note: Arm A admits every REFERENCES terminal; arm B is the code as committed, which admits only type-like names. Both arms index the SAME working tree, so the only variable is the transport. The `find` string must match exactly once or the arm fails rather than reporting a null. NOTE: an earlier version of this spec toggled the mergeRows External exclusion instead and measured ZERO — correctly, because after 40bc05a the stubs that bypass would elevate are never minted in the first place. The two defects were coupled, so that transport is no longer a single meaningful variable at this commit. Recorded rather than deleted.

arms.name: A-admit-all-references
arms.describes: every REFERENCES terminal admitted, including bare local names

arms.name: B-type-like-only
arms.describes: as committed: only type-like REFERENCES terminals are admitted
